description: This PHP source file defines the AdministratorAccessController class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the admin access page by setting up Vue components and handling user authentication attributes, including CSRF tokens, back URLs, and error messaging. It interacts with services such as HomePageService and uses traits for authentication and ORM helpers.

classes.name: AdministratorAccessController
classes.description: Controller managing the administrator access authentication page, responsible for preparing the Vue component with user info, CSRF token, and handling redirection URLs.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of HomePageService to be used for retrieving homepage path.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the authentication admin access page by setting up Vue component properties such as error messages, back URLs, username, and CSRF token based on user session and request parameters.
